caseName: Marburger v. Public Funds for Public Schools of New Jersey
caseNameFull: Marburger, Commissioner of Education of New Jersey v. Public Funds for Public Schools of New Jersey

opinions.text: D. C. N. J. Application for stay of injunction heretofore granted by this Court on May 29, 1973 [412 U. S. 916], vacated. For the reasons stated in the dissenting opinions in Committee for Public Education & Religious Liberty v. Ny-*917quist, and companion cases, and Sloan v. Lemon, and companion case, ante, pp. 798, 805, 813, The Chief Justice, Mr. Justice White, and Mr. Justice Rehnquist dissent from the vacation of stay of the District Court’s preliminary injunction.
